name: Polyhedral Cell Definition
definition: The encoder-induced polyhedral cell $\mathcal{C}_{\mathbf{x}}$ for a point $\mathbf{x}$ is defined as the intersection of the tetrahedra $\mathcal{T}^{(\ell)}(\mathbf{x})$ containing $\mathbf{x}$ across all resolution levels $\ell \in \{0, \dots, L-1\}$.
